description: Authorize the personal-list and social tools with your AniList account (one-time). Prerequisite: register an app at anilist.co/settings/developer with Redirect URL set to `http://localhost:8082/callback` (the default; override the port via ANILIST_OAUTH_PORT if 8082 is taken — it must match exactly what you register), and set ANILIST_CLIENT_ID + ANILIST_CLIENT_SECRET in the server env. Calling this returns an authorization URL: open it, log in, and click Approve. If your browser genuinely runs on the same machine as this server, login then completes automatically; otherwise copy the URL you land on and pass it to submit_anilist_redirect. `auto_capture` in the response is NOT a reliable detector of that — it only reflects whether this server process could bind its own localhost listener, which typically succeeds even when the server runs remotely (SSH/headless) and the browser can never reach it; you (or the user) know the actual machine layout, the response doesn't.
name: login_anilist

authorize_url.description: The AniList OAuth authorization URL — open it in a browser and click Approve.

auto_capture.description: Whether this server process could bind a local callback listener — NOT whether the browser opening authorize_url is actually on the same machine. A remote/SSH server can still bind its own loopback port successfully and read `true` here even though that browser's redirect can never reach it.

redirect_uri.description: The exact localhost callback URI this login attempt used (port from ANILIST_OAUTH_PORT, default 8082) — must exactly match the Redirect URL registered for your AniList app, or the token exchange fails.

title: Log in to AniList
